title: Bound on Head-Descriptor Numbers
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $h$ be a head descriptor, consisting of an optional state and one of three output-status values. Its number in the fixed enumeration of head descriptors is strictly less than the total number of such descriptors.
